title: Interaction: Sunfire Energy Beam × water
keywords: magic interaction Sunfire Energy Beam   water
answer: Sunfire Energy Beam × water: The nearest sampled water boundary converts only that damage beat into a radius-three, eight-target steam pulse at 65% base damage, with bounded consent-safe motion and no ignition. Signature: Pale pressure rune, cloud bloom, extinguish hiss, and interaction clash.
